primary_endpoint: At 72 weeks, resolution of NASH with no worsening of fibrosis.
efficacy_outcome: NASH resolution without worsening fibrosis occurred in 40%, 36%, and 59% with semaglutide 0.1, 0.2, and 0.4 mg, respectively, versus 17% with placebo; for 0.4 mg versus placebo, P<0.001.
safety_signal: With semaglutide 0.4 mg versus placebo, nausea occurred in 42% vs. 11%, constipation in 22% vs. 12%, and vomiting in 15% vs. 2%. Malignant neoplasms occurred in 3 semaglutide-treated patients (1%) and no placebo-treated patients.
